items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: When he, when, when, when Bro and them was with Duke, see?

ctx.x: But it's funny, uh, uh, uh, you're the one that tell about, bro, about the Creole deal.

Uh, Sonny Greer was telling me this, uh, says, uh, they was playing in, uh, Birmingham, Alabama. And, uh, Sonny says, uh, Sonny says, actually, he says, nobody can tell that I'm, uh, colored, he says, uh. So, Sonny says, he went right downtown and started, and went in, uh, a white restaurant. Sonny Greer did? Yeah, Sonny Greer. When he, when, when, when Bro and them was with Duke, see? Okay. And Sonny says, uh, he was sitting in there, eating, and, uh, he says, Bro happened to pass by. And Bro seen him in there.…
And Sonny, you know who could pass the best? Sonny had his hair all gassed and everything. Yeah. Sonny says, man, he says, I was all straight and everything.
